subject: project:gdl
value: The hosted Linux run for b9a163353 built and checksum-verified the DOL, then failed the analysis suite with one failure and nine errors. The log shows hardcoded Windows objdump paths in the shared fndiff/fnasm consumers and a test that mutates the process-wide os.name, causing pathlib to instantiate WindowsPath on Linux. Its progress output also reports that the container's ninja command lacks the dependency-listing tool required by provenance. Local Windows gates alone had not exposed these failures. This change selects native binutils names without file-existence fallback, makes the test mock local to the probe, and pins diagnostic-capable Ninja in CI without weakening provenance or skipping tests. Hosted run 34006636433 for 21651dbe8 subsequently passed the build, checksum, both full suites, graph validation and reconstruction diagnostics; confirmed before formal main-branch acceptance.
